props.caption: The reported strikes sat near Khasab on the Omani side of the Hormuz narrows.
Derby manufacturing, battery trains and terminal chargers turn the order into a hardware clock.
The forecast turns on the next visible vessel count through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.note: Reports put projectiles near Khasab, with two vessels hit and one fire, while attribution remains unassigned.
The forecast turns on whether the next visible daily transit count stays below the 15-vessel average.
Alstom names Derby manufacturing from 2028 for 29 five-car battery-electric trains.
ONS put July GDP growth at 0.4%, with services carrying the monthly print.
The Bank of France intervention turns debt cancellation into a treaty, default and budget test.
The Tiananmen-vigil sentences attach prison terms and a fine to public memory.

lead.what: Hong Kong records prison terms of seven years three months, seven years and five years two months in the Tiananmen-vigil case, with a HK$1.5m Alliance fine.

rest.what: The reported strike has location, vessel count and one fire, but no established vessel identities or responsibility.

lead.what: Reuters put Thursday transits at seven against a 15-vessel average. The next visible Friday count decides whether the low-traffic condition carries into a second reading.

rest.what: Moulin's intervention leaves the debt-cancellation proposal waiting on securities, treaty authority and default treatment.

lead.what: The TransPennine order names 29 five-car units, manufacturing from 2028 and delivery from 2032.

rest.what: ONS put July GDP growth at 0.4%, with services also up 0.4% and programming contributing 0.12 percentage points.
